facts.fact: The voter ID can be downloaded online as an e-EPIC from ECI's electors services
facts.quote: 3 Download Voter ID (E-EPIC) Download electronic copy of EPIC Card

facts.fact: The e-EPIC is downloaded through ECI's Voters' Service Portal (voters.eci.gov.in)
facts.quote: Download of e-EPIC:You can download a digital copy of your EPIC (e-EPIC) online through the VSP.

facts.fact: To download, enter the EPIC number or the Form Reference Number and verify the OTP sent to the registered mobile
facts.quote: Enter EPIC Number or Form Reference Number Verify the OTP sent on the registered mobile number Click on Download e-EPIC
facts.note: The steps are on ECI's older e-EPIC page (it names NVSP, since replaced by the Voters' Service Portal); the current eci.gov.in pages name the service but not the steps.

summary: Confirmed: e-EPIC download via ECI's Voters' Service Portal using the EPIC number or form reference number.
